note: Late checkout by Hilton Honors tier and occupancy, plus sign-up offer. Rules from Akash 2026-11-09: Diamond Reserve 4 PM (HH-11); Diamond 1 PM at <=60% occupancy else 12:30 PM; Gold 1 PM at <=40% else 12 PM; Silver 12:30 PM at <=40% else 12 PM; Member/non-member 12 PM; joins at the desk: 12:30 PM, 1 PM at <=40%.

sops.title: Late checkout by Honors tier
sops.kw: late checkout, late check out, honors late checkout, diamond late checkout, gold late checkout, silver late checkout, stay later, checkout time, occupancy, honors member checkout

steps.t: Ask if the guest is a Hilton Honors member and check their tier on the reservation in PEP.
Check tonight's occupancy in PEP before you promise a time.
Diamond Reserve: 4 PM is guaranteed. Follow HH-11 to confirm the time they really need.
Diamond: up to 1 PM when occupancy is 60% or lower. Above 60%, up to 12:30 PM.
Gold: up to 1 PM when occupancy is 40% or lower. Otherwise 12 PM.
Silver: up to 12:30 PM when occupancy is 40% or lower. Otherwise 12 PM.
Not a member? This is your chance: offer to enroll them right now (HH-01). If they join at the desk, give them 12:30 PM, or up to 1 PM when occupancy is 40% or lower.
Past these times, a full night is charged unless a manager approves it.
Set the time in PEP (Stay tab > Departure Time), post it in the housekeeping WhatsApp chat, and log it in Quore (SH-12).
steps.hampton: Set the time in PEP (Stay tab > Departure Time), post it in the Hampton HK WhatsApp chat, and log it in Quore (SH-12).

sops.script: "Are you a Hilton Honors member? Let me see what I can do for you." Not a member: "If you join Hilton Honors right now, it's free, and I can give you a later checkout today."
sops.flag: The guest wants later than their tier allows. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Late checkout request
sops.kw: late check out, late checkout, stay later, extend checkout, leave later

steps.t: Ask if the guest is a Hilton Honors member and which tier, then follow HH-13. Members get more time depending on tier and occupancy, and non-members can join on the spot for a later checkout.
steps.hk: Skip this step at this hotel.

steps.t: Look at tonight's occupancy and whether housekeeping can still finish every room on time. Reach out to housekeeping before you approve.
Limit how many late checkouts you give. With teams, if one member gets it the rest will ask too.
After {Late check-out cutoff}, a full night is charged unless a manager waives it.
Update the departure time in PEP and tell housekeeping.
steps.hk: Update the departure time in HotelKey and tell housekeeping.

sops.script: "I can give you until ___. After {Late check-out cutoff} we do have to charge a full night."
sops.flag: The guest wants past {Late check-out cutoff} without the charge. Call {AGM}.
